text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Here we are! We've finally arrived~.
In Kyoto, city of shrines and temples, it's time for the big showdown for the Chrysanthemum!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, all the hardships that led up to this point
flash before my eyes like a revolving lantern...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
choice_data_list: This is no time to be dying...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! The battle is just beginning.
It starts right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The daunting Kikuka Sho. A 3000m
hellish long-distance race is a first for me. But..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it'll work out somehow! After all,
I've gathered up a massive hoard of good luck!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Sic 'em, lady luck! Beat our rivals and
that slope of Yodo into a pulp!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And I'm just supposed to watch, huh...
choice_data_list: No more just watching, I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yeees, I know~!
I made sure to drink Daikichi Milk today so I won't get worn out.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
If I can break through here, my faith will be invincible.
O God, show that luck is almighty~!
